queries: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT status, site_count, site_count::numeric / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT status, site_count, CAST(site_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT status, record_count, CAST(record_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts;

WITH counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS conserved_sites FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT insurance_status, conserved_sites, CAST(conserved_sites AS numeric) / SUM(conserved_sites) OVER () AS share FROM counts;

WITH counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS conservation_records FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT insurance_status, conservation_records, CAST(conservation_records AS numeric) / SUM(conservation_records) OVER () AS share FROM counts;

assumptions.assumption: A conserved site is counted once per insurance status, even if it has multiple conservation records.

alternatives.interpretation: Count conservation records rather than distinct conserved sites.

assumptions.assumption: A site with multiple conservation records counts once. A NULL insurance status forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count conservation records rather than distinct conserved sites.
